public_state.prompt: Escape the five-terrace crater with the brass walker. Follow the highlighted TRANSFER LEG card: release that indicated support safely, tune its yaw/lift/extend channels, lower it onto a real raised ledge, then SETTLE. Keep three feet supporting the body, read the 3D slope, and let the body advance over the terrain before committing the next transfer. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

rules.camera: Orbit the viewport to inspect near and far feet. Camera motion changes only the view, not the world or success condition.
rules.channels: Each leg has signed YAW, LIFT, and EXTEND controls. A high lift releases a foot; a low lift can contact a visible pad.
rules.finish: The whole body must reach the outside ledge with four supporting contacts and an upright posture.
rules.posture: The brass body tilts from the 3D height relationship among its contacting feet; an excessive roll or pitch fails the attempt.
rules.support: A settle is safe only with at least three distinct load-bearing feet. A released leg must land on the next terrace's support pad to advance.
rules.transfer_marker: The next transfer leg is visibly named in the TRANSFER LEG banner and highlighted on its leg card.
rules.transit: A valid landing starts a four-settle body transit over the raised support terrain; the body advances one visible pose per settle.

server_grade.feedback: replayed 28 settles across 4 support transfers with four final contacts
